name: Cantarella

tierList.prydwen: T3 Tower of Adversity, T1.5 Whimpering Wastes (Hybrid)

kit.intro: 5-star Havoc Rectifier Hybrid combining on/off-field damage (Coordinated Attacks via Diffusion/Dreamweavers), healing, and an Outro buff (20% Havoc DMG + 25% Skill DMG). Two Forte resources: Trance (max 5, unlocks Mirage state via enhanced Heavy Attack) and Shiver (max 3 while in Mirage, unlocks nuke 'Perception Drain').

skills.normalAttack: Illusion Collapse - 3-hit chain; in Mirage becomes 'Phantom Sting' (3-hit, triggers Coordinated Attacks on stage 3).
skills.resonanceSkill: Dance with Shadows - Graceful Step (base) / Flickering Reverie in Mirage (Echo-type, applies Hazy Dream slow+Jolt DoT).
skills.forte: Between Illusion and Reality - governs Mirage state (enhanced basics/mid-air/dodge) and Perception Drain (Shiver-consuming nuke + heal); Abyssal Rebirth restores Concerto Energy on Echo Skill casts (up to 6x/25s).
skills.liberation: Beneath the Sea (Flowing Suffocation) - Havoc DMG + grants team Diffusion (up to 21 Dreamweaver Coordinated Attacks over 30s).
skills.intro: Cruise (Ripple) - Havoc DMG, starts Basic chain at stage 3, gains Trance.
skills.outro: Gentle Tentacles - next character gains 20% Havoc DMG + 25% Resonance Skill DMG Amplify for 14s.

echoSet: Moonlit Clouds (best in non-Havoc teams, sacrifices personal damage for buffing)

mainStats.cost3: Havoc DMG; Havoc DMG > Energy Regen

teams.name: Team #1: Best Team
teams.notes: Cantarella is Phrolova's best teammate - her actions count as Echo Skills, feeding Phrolova's enhanced-attack mechanic, and Phrolova doesn't care about Cantarella's poor Energy generation.

teams.name: Team #3: Skill Damage Teams
teams.notes: Niche substitute for dedicated Skill-DPS supports; generally outclassed by Zhezhi/Yinlin due to Cantarella's severe Energy Regen needs.

rotation: Intro (Ripple) -> Basic P3 -> Skill (Graceful Step) -> Ultimate (Flowing Suffocation) -> Heavy (Delusive Dive, enter Mirage) -> Skill (Flickering Reverie) -> Phantom Sting P1-P3 -> Skill (Perception Drain) -> Echo -> Outro.
communityNotes: Prydwen: strong multi-role kit (damage + heal + buff) but suffers severe Energy Regen requirements that hurt both her own damage and her teammates' builds; lacks a clearly best-in-slot DPS partner as of 3.2 review aside from Phrolova, making her pull value more speculative than cemented pending a future synergistic release/rerun.
